title: The shop windows and the glass that breaks
summary: A shop in Supermarket Simulator is glazed rather than walled: the build names four shop windows with shard versions beside them, a glass material, shards in three strengths, dust on glass and a window to clean.
body: A shop in Supermarket Simulator is glazed rather than walled. The game names four windows of its own, a front left and a front right beside a left and a right one, so the shopfront is assembled from pieces rather than left as a gap in a wall.
Each window carries a shard version as well. A broken window is not the same object as an intact one, which is why the game can swap the pane for its pieces rather than only play a sound over it.
The glass itself is a material of its own, with a colour sheet and a normal map beside it, so a pane reflects and shades without the game drawing a separate window for every angle.

Dust is part of the job. The build carries dust for glass with maps of its own, and a window is a thing that can be cleaned, which is why a shop's windows are part of keeping the place presentable rather than pure decoration.

There are display cases glassed to match. One showcase material is carried with a fade, a metallic smoothness and a normal sheet beside it, so what is behind the glass can be looked through rather than hidden.

Cars are glazed from the same vocabulary. A saloon and an SUV are each named with their own glass and shard pieces, with a tempered-glass material beside them, so the same idea of a pane and its pieces runs through the vehicles.
The shopfront windows come as a numbered set, and the window has a background and a bubble particle of its own, so what a passer-by sees through the glass is drawn rather than left as an empty hole.

What this entry does not tell you: how much a window costs to replace, whether a broken one changes what customers do, or how long dust takes to build up. We have not verified those, so we do not print them.

facts.evidence: asset names: Window_Front_Left, Window_Front_Right, Window_Left, Window_Right, Window_Front_Left_Shards, Window_Front_Right_Shards, Window_Left_Shards, Window_Right_Shards

facts.claim: The glass is a material of its own with a colour sheet and a normal map beside it.
facts.evidence: asset names: Glass_A, Glass_N, Glass_MS, Glass1

facts.claim: Shards come in tiers: a plain shard set with an easy, a medium and a strong version beside it.
facts.evidence: asset names: Shards, Shards_Easy, Shards_Medium, Shards_Strong

facts.claim: Dust for glass is named with maps of its own, and a window is named as something that can be cleaned.
facts.evidence: asset names: M_Dust_For_Glass, T_Dust_For_Glass_MA, T_Dust_For_Glass_N, Window Cleaning

facts.claim: A display case is glassed as well, with a fade, a metallic smoothness and a normal sheet beside it.
facts.evidence: asset names: Glass_Showcase, Glass_Showcase_Fade, Glass_Showcase_MS, Glass_Showcase_N

facts.claim: A saloon and an SUV are each named with their own glass pieces, with a tempered-glass material beside them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Suv_Car_01_Glass, Suv_Car_01_Glass_A, T_Sedan_glass_AlbedoTransparency, TemperGlass

facts.claim: The shopfront windows come as a numbered set.
facts.evidence: asset names: Sm_Store_Window_1, Sm_Store_Window_2, Sm_Store_Window_3, Sm_Store_Window_4, Sm_Store_Window_5

facts.claim: The window has a background and a bubble particle of its own.
facts.evidence: asset names: Window BG, Window Bubble Particle

alt.zh: 游戏自带的窗户图集：网格排布的窗帘窗、百叶窗与普通玻璃。

alt.en: The strip of white shard shapes the game cuts a broken window into, drawn on a transparent field.
alt.zh: 游戏把碎窗切成的一列白色碎玻璃形状，绘在透明底上。
